arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST\nJISME HUSSAIN OORYAAN, OON DAR BAYAABAAN AST\nAY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
english translation text: O SHIAS, TONIGHT IS SHAM-E-GHARIBAN\nTHE BLESSED BODY OF HUSSAIN LIES BARE THERE IN THE WILDERNESS\nO SHIAS, TONIGHT IS SHAM-E-GHARIBAN

arabic text: DAR KARBALA IMSHAB, ZAARI-O-AFGHAAN AST\nJISME ALI AKBAR, OON DAR BAYAABAAN AST
english translation text: IN KARBALA TONIGHT, THERE IS WEEPING AND LAMENTATION\nTHE BLESSED BODY OF ALI AKBAR LIES THERE IN THE WILDERNESS

arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
BA HAALATE MAHZOON, CHOON NA SHA HAR DAR KHOON\nBAR DEEDANE OONHA, HAR CHASHME GIRYAAN AST
english translation text: IN A STATE OF SORROW, AS THE SHAH LIES IN BLOOD\nAT THE SIGHT OF THEM, EVERY EYE IS WEEPING

arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
CHOON ZAYNABE MAHZOON, BAA DEEDAN-E-GIRYAAN\nGUFT AY BIRAADAR JAAN, MAA BEEKAS AUR YAAREEM
english translation text: WHEN GRIEF-STRICKEN ZAINAB SAW THIS WITH WEEPING EYES\nSHE SAID: O DEAR BROTHER, WE ARE HELPLESS AND WITHOUT SUPPORT

arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
KHATME RASOOL AAYAD, BA JUMLAAE HAMRAAHAN\nAZ QATLE FARZANDASH, GIRYA-O-NAALAAN AST
english translation text: THE SEAL OF THE PROPHETS ARRIVES, WITH ALL THOSE WITH HIM\nOVER THE MARTYRDOM OF HIS BELOVED CHILD, HE WEEPS AND LAMENTS

arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
ZAAKI DAR EEN MAJLIS, SIDDIQE QUBRA HAST\nAZ DAAGHE FARZANDASH, BA QALBE SOOZAAN AST
english translation text: ZAAKI, IN THIS MAJLIS, SIDDIQAH-E-KUBRA IS PRESENT\nHER HEART BURNS WITH THE GRIEF OF HER MARTYRED SON

arabic text: AY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST\nJISME HUSSAIN OORYAAN, OON DAR BAYAABAAN AST\nAY SHIAYUN IMSHAB, SHAAME GHARIBAAN AST
english translation text: O SHIAS, TONIGHT IS SHAM-E-GHARIBAN\nTHE BLESSED BODY OF HUSSAIN LIES BARE THERE IN THE WILDERNESS\nO SHIAS, TONIGHT IS SHAM-E-GHARIBAN
